question: In a certain code language, ‘EARS’ is coded as ‘4259’ and ‘SARI’ is coded as ‘9725’. What is the code for ‘I’ in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

"EARS’ is coded as ‘4259’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79b925096f137f4ae25ca67546d911a414ee2cc813b5e6dc0459f01dca6fd5d7.png] 

‘SARI’ is coded as ‘9725’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc3a7fee066a42dd13bfcbf0dae999e492e5b364dd83bdd80a612078ea8e2f49.png] 

So, '**7**' is the code for ‘I’ in the given code language

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
